general_draft: Pricing is based on the drawings, specifications, addenda, and written clarifications identified in this proposal.
Work not expressly included in this proposal is excluded.
Changes in scope, schedule, access, quantities, or site conditions may require a written change order.
Final field dimensions, backing, blocking, utilities, and substrate conditions are by others unless expressly included.
Taxes, bonds, permits, testing, special inspections, and prevailing-wage requirements are excluded unless expressly included.
Material lead times and pricing are subject to manufacturer availability and written acceptance of this proposal.
